## Scored rows and formula

The weighted total is `0.30*harm + 0.20*reach + 0.15*institutions + 0.15*procedural_abuse + 0.10*self_dealing + 0.10*persistence`, rounded to two decimals. Dimension values are 0–10 in one-decimal increments. No decimal jitter was used.

| `entry-4217` | 0.0 / 2.0 / 2.0 / 2.0 / 0.0 / 2.0 | 1.20 | Supplied AP/ESPN context records Trump’s call about a one-game ban and FIFA’s later deferral, allowing one player to play in one match. Scores reflect only bounded reach and limited pressure; the sequence is not a causal finding or proof of a rule violation. Norway’s related complaint was still under consideration, and a separate filed letter concerned another matter. |
